basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Principal AI Engineer | Multi-Agent Systems & Production LLM Platforms | Hands-on Tech Lead
basics.summary: Hands-on principal engineer who architects, reviews, and ships agentic systems in production. Built and operates the AI agent platform at LumApps: multi-agent orchestration, knowledge-graph grounding (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep), evaluation and observability via Langfuse. 13+ years owning the technical core of products used by 10M+ users; technical lead at Beekeeper across CrewAI, Strands Agents, OpenAI, and LangChain. Three companies founded on the side, so I know what owning a product feels like.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Owns the technical core of the AI agent platform end-to-end: architecture, multi-agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, and rollout. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Architected and shipped production multi-agent systems for outbound sales. Tool design, reasoning loops, grounding, context windows. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours saved per rep per day. Forecast: $4M approved opportunities per quarter, $1M revenue at 25% conversion.

Built AI Brain, a knowledge-graph context layer (Neo4j, Graphiti, Zep) that grounds production agents in structured business intelligence. Unifies 8+ data silos so agents reason over typed relationships, not vector chunks.

Owned the reliability layer: Langfuse for evaluation and observability, replay-driven evals on a golden set, prompt regression gates before rollout. Agent behaviour measurable and dependable, not vibes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Hands-on technical lead operating like a founding engineer. Owned architecture, code review, and engineering standards across a high-calibre AI cohort while shipping production AI for 10M+ users.
highlights: Built and operated multiple production AI systems on real traffic: AI Onboarding Specialist, GenAI demo generator, LLM translation pipeline. Real users, real failure modes, full evaluation and observability stack (Langfuse, CrewAI, Strands Agents).
Replaced $337K in annual vendor translation costs with an LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. 12K+ assets translated. Same-day turnaround vs the vendor's 2 weeks.
Led Search Platform revamp across 3 teams. Redesigned indexing, ranking, and retrieval; raised the engineering bar on code review, CI, and modular architecture for downstream AI components.
Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort. Set engineering standards for AI code: modular components, evaluation harnesses, observability by default. Engineers now lead AI features independently.

work.name: Tenity
work.summary: Technology panelist for seed-to-VC stage startups. Reviews architecture, evaluates AI readiness, and advises founders on multi-agent system design.
highlights: Evaluated 20+ startups on production AI architecture, multi-agent design, and cloud-native scalability. Findings inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Advised portfolio companies on agentic workflows, evaluation pipelines, and engineering standards that ship to real users.

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Owned end-to-end architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and the algorithms that made 500+ deliveries possible.
highlights: Architected and shipped the end-to-end platform (Vue, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS). 500+ autonomous deliveries; partnerships with Unilever and a CES showcase. Production-grade reliability from day one.
Built CI/CD pipeline and cloud infrastructure from scratch. Real-time flight control APIs and logistics optimization: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI research at the frontier of robotics. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms. Foundational AI work that underpins my multi-agent systems craft today.
highlights: Engineered Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot bodies and brains via genetic algorithms. Distributed multi-agent simulation across artificial selection cycles.
Migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel evolution runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, fitness landscapes, learning from environment) that directly informs how I architect agent reasoning loops today.

projects.name: PulseView - AI Market Intelligence
projects.description: Production agentic system that carries market analysis through to a finished, explainable result. Built for my own trading portfolio first, then opened to retail traders.
highlights: Real-time multi-agent system that generates signals AND justifies them. Live users, real money, evaluation loop on every signal. Core principle: if the model can't justify the signal, it doesn't ship.

projects.name: Proplab - AI for Real Estate
projects.description: AI-native platform for small real estate teams. Vision models turn inspection photos into structured records; LLM agents turn those records into marketing-ready listings, end-to-end.
highlights: End-to-end agent workflow from photo capture to published listing: vision pipeline extracts structured signals, LLM agents generate multilingual listings, human approval gate before publish.

projects.name: SwissNRI - AI Cross-border Fintech
projects.description: AI-native platform for Swiss-Indian families navigating FEMA, DTAA, and Swiss tax regulations. Zero digital alternatives existed: just spreadsheets and expensive advisors.
highlights: RAG-grounded tax assistant that answers cross-border compliance questions with citations back to the source regulation. AI agents flag DTAA and FEMA risks before users file.

_jobApplication.jobTitle: Principal Engineer / Engineering Lead — Agentic AI
_jobApplication.jobDescription: Principal Engineer / Engineering Lead, Agentic AI at NWS Management AG (executive search; client is a fast-growing Zurich-based B2B AI software company and Microsoft partner). Hands-on IC/tech-lead role owning the technical core of an agentic platform on Azure. Architect multi-agent systems and artefact generation; production-grade reliability via evaluation, regression, observability; backend on Azure plus React/TypeScript frontend (approval/audit UI); raise engineering standards across a small high-calibre team. Bring substantial senior/staff/principal experience, production AI agents (not chat wrappers), multi-agent orchestration, cloud-native/Azure background, modern AI/agent tooling (orchestration frameworks, evals, MCP-style connectors, Azure AI Foundry). On-site Zurich; English working language.
